0022600205.text: The Washington Wizards (4-6, 9th in the East and 2.5 games back in the Southeast) visit the Detroit Pistons (6-3, 1st in the Central) for Washington's 11th game of the season, with the Wizards on a three-game losing streak and 2-4 on the road. Washington is without Bilal Coulibaly (hand), Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), while Detroit is missing Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain) and has lost its last two games. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and their last meeting came in Washington on March 19, when the Wizards lost 117-95; in the 2025-26 season series, the Wizards lost 1-3.
